title: Staged FP8 Activation with Telemetry Augmentor and Evaluation Harness for Hopper E4M3/E5M2
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Safely enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) quantization profiles on Hopper fleet by introducing a staged activation flow augmented by richer telemetry and a targeted evaluation harness. This ticket covers the integration glue (selector hooks + calibration runner), the telemetry augmentation layer, accuracy validation datasets, rollout gating, and a fast rollback plan.

Motivation: Prior FP8 rollouts have shown intermittent numeric instability on long-sequence workloads and sensitivity to prefix caching and KV cache state. Instead of a single global flip, we will implement temporal/staggered activation windows and richer signal collection to detect early drift and regressions.

Success criteria (high level):
- No customer-facing accuracy regressions exceeding 0.5% BLEU/Rouge-like metric or 2% relative on internal semantic-similarity evals on Canary traffic.
- Latency delta <= 8% p50 and p99 within SLO for enabled shards.
- Automated gating prevents activation on a shard if the golden-seed concordance score falls below threshold.
- Rollback to INT8/FP32 variant within 3 minutes for affected shard via orchestration playbook.

Scope and approach:
1) Telemetry Augmentor: extend runtime telemetry to emit per-request numeric fingerprint deltas (kv-cache checksums, prefix-entropy, per-layer activation norm histograms) and enrich existing token-level traces with quantization-mode metadata (profile id, scaling factors). Add a lightweight aggregator service that computes shard-level concordance scores, variance spikes, and drift windows.
2) Calibration pipeline improvements: integrate micro-batch recalibration that can run in shadow mode (no live traffic) and produce profile deltas. Add deterministic golden-seed evaluation (fixed random seeds, 1024-sample paired inputs) to measure numerical drift vs baseline.
3) Eval harness: standardize an evaluation suite that includes: long-context summarization, instruction-following turn-taking, and semantic-similarity embeddings. Outputs: token-level divergence, semantic delta distribution, and end-to-end quality heuristics.
4) Staged activation: three phases — shadow (telemetry + shadow inference), dark-launch (small fraction of live requests with write-only metrics), and live-small (1–5% live traffic), followed by gradual ramp if concordance scores remain green. Add temporal windows so adjacent shards are not activated simultaneously to reduce correlated risk.
5) Gating & rollback: define concordance score thresholding, hysteresis (grace window of N minutes), and orchestrator hooks to immediately switch affected shard back to a compatible profile. Implement an automated rollback playbook with human-in-the-loop alerting for P0 regressions.
6) Observability and dashboards: new panels for per-profile activation norms, drift heatmaps, golden-seed regression timelines, and activation correlation with latency/error spikes.

Implementation tasks (high level):
- Runtime: add quant-mode metadata header and lightweight checksum emission (Marcus).
- Telemetry Augmentor: new service + aggregation rules (SRE + Observability).
- Calibration Runner: modify shadow pipeline to accept micro-batches and produce profile-deltas (Aisha).
- Eval Suite: curate seed sets, implement metric collectors and threshold calculators (Research/Applied ML).
- Orchestration: tie gating to rollout engine and add API for fast rollback (Platform team).
- Dashboards & Alerts: panels + alert rules + runbook links (Observability team).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: False positives from noisy workloads. Mitigation: use ensemble of metrics (concordance + latency pattern + semantic delta) before gating.
- Risk: Calibration overfit to golden-seed. Mitigation: maintain a secondary randomized sample set and require improvement across both.
- Risk: Activation-induced tail latency. Mitigation: limit concurrent activations and pre-warm KV caches.

Rollout plan: start with internal-only shards in us-west-2 (non-critical), run 2-week shadow + 48-hour dark-launch, then live-small with 24-hour hold for gating evaluation. If green, incremental ramp over 4 weeks.

Notes: this ticket is implementation-heavy; coordinate with Release Engineering for canary windows and with Security for review of any telemetry payloads (PII check).
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry Augmentor emits per-request quant-mode metadata and per-shard concordance scores to telemetry pipeline
Calibration Runner produces profile-deltas and can run in shadow; outputs are stored in GCS with deterministic IDs
Eval harness completes automated golden-seed runs and reports semantic delta metrics; thresholds documented
Orchestration hooks allow immediate rollback of a shard and execute within 3 minutes when triggered
Dashboards for activation health, drift, and latency are available and linked in runbook
Staged activation completed on at least 3 non-critical shards with no customer-impacting regressions
